name: io.github.CamposCodes/taiga-r2da-mcp
description: Read a Taiga 6 installation and, when allowed, create, edit, move and delete its items.

environmentVariables.description: Address of the Taiga site, starting with https://
environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Session token of Taiga 6, copied from the browser after login
environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: 1 or true registers the tools that create and edit user stories, tasks and issues
environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: 1 or true registers the tool that deletes; it needs TAIGA_WRITE on
environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_DELETE
